headline: Moody’s upgrades Egypt to B3 on fiscal reforms, keeps positive outlook
summary: Investing.com -- Moody’s Ratings upgraded Egypt’s long-term issuer ratings to B3 from Caa1 on Friday, maintaining a positive outlook on the sovereign. The upgrade underscores a period of sustained fiscal consolidation and structural economic reforms that have successfully placed public debt metrics on a downward trajectory.

headline: RBC Capital Maintains Outperform on Moodys, Lowers Price Target to $575
summary: RBC Capital  analyst Ashish Sabadra   maintains Moodys (NYSE:MCO) with a Outperform and lowers the price target from $610 to $575.

headline: High Rates Have Upturned How Moody’s Looks at Credit Risk, Chief Credit Officer Says
summary: Leverage matters more now because interest costs are rising, said Atsi Sheth, the ratings company’s chief credit officer.

headline: The IPO drought is driving private equity-owned companies to the debt market to pay investors
summary: Private equity firms are increasingly using debt-funded dividend recaps to return cash to investors as exits remain subdued.
